notes: Four chapters remain on three physical story objects. Product development now advances through process, comparison, expertise and closing, with footer and keyboard back/forward navigation.
Comparison distinguishes task delegation from automation already used in conventional development. No unmeasured productivity claims or unconditional autonomous-delivery claims are made.

All 204 main story states remain centered and within their model. The comparison, expertise and closing also fit six PC window sizes, including 960 by 540, without scrolling, clipping or stretched glyphs.

The 44 cm rounded oak coffee table follows the sofa orientation, carries an articulated journal, coffee and saucer, coasters, linen, flowers and a slatted book shelf. Coffee steam and inspection move with the mug.

Perpendicular windows load distinct courtyard and side-orchard seasonal atlases. Weather and season remain synchronized; cloud and precipitation phases and celestial projections vary with each window.
All fifteen direct living-object interactions, temporary chalk, independent curtains and doors, user-initiated music, journal turns, gaze and fixed hologram unfolding pass.
Production preview now sends explicit content lengths, avoiding the interrupted chunked image loads observed in the original local test service.

assets.models: Procedural rounded coffee table and additional ceramic/linen/botanical details
